__NOTOC__{{Recipe summary|Name=Chukauni|Time=20 minutes|Category=Side dish recipes|Difficulty=1|Servings=2}}{{Recipe}}

'''Chukauni''' is a potato salad dish from Palpa district in Nepal.<ref>https://sampurnaweekly.com/news/1141</ref> It is mainly served with [[Cookbook:Chapati|roti]], [[Cookbook:Steamed Rice|steamed rice]] or [[Cookbook:Medu Vada (South Indian Savory Lentil Donut)|batuk]].

== Ingredients ==

* 4 [[Cookbook:Boiled potatoes|boiled potatoes]], peeled and roughly [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]]
* 200 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yoghurt]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Chiles|chiles]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], chopped
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] mustard oil
* Salt to taste
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]] powder
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Fenugreek|fenugreek seeds]]
* [[Cookbook:Chiles|Chile]] powder (optional)
* 2 dried red chiles (optional)

== Equipment ==

* Large bowl
* Ladle
* Small pan or [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]]
* Bowls to serve
* Spoons

== Procedure ==

# Put the boiled potatoes in a bowl.
# Add chopped chilies and chilies.
# Pour the yoghurt over the potatoes.
# Add salt and red chili powder as per your taste.
# In a small wok or pan, heat some oil with red chilies and fenugreek seed.
# When the seeds turn black, remove the pan from heat.
# Add turmeric powder over the oil immediately.
# Pour the oil over the potatoes and yoghurt mixture.
# Mix the mixture evenly with a ladle or a spoon.
